name: Dragon, Iron
body:
IRON DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

This hulking metal dragon is covered in huge iron scales which crackle with electricity.

XP 1,200
LG Small dragon (electricity)
Init +0; Senses dragon senses; Perception -1

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 11, flat-footed 21 (+10 natural, +1 size)
hp 52 (5d12+20)
Fort +7, Ref +2, Will +3
DR 1/magic; Immune electricity, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses Vulnerability to sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +7 (1d6+1), 2 claws +7 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks breath weapon (40-ft. line, DC 15, 4d4 electricity, once per 1d4 rounds)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 10, Con 17, Int 14, Wis 9, Cha 10
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 16 (20 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Natural Armor, Power Attack, Toughness
Skills Fly +8, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +10, Knowledge (engineering) +10, Perform (oratory) +5, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +4, Survival +7, Swim +10
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
